description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marang River Prowler, adding {C}{C}.
Marang River Prowler dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Marang River Prowler from your graveyard by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat.
